item.title: Design a News Feed System
item.author: abhaypratap3537@gmail.com (Abhay)
item.description: Fan-out on write or fan-out on read? Build a Facebook-style feed for 10 million daily users, understand exactly why one celebrity account breaks the obvious design, and see the hybrid that every large platform actually ships.
